notes.title: HD Update now live!
notes.content:
The HD update for Hotel Giant 2 is now live and available for all users.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Widescreen support with additional resolutions of 1600x1200, 1680x1050, 1920x1080 and 1920x1200
[*]Some tweaks to optimize support on newer OS (Win 7 / 8) 
[*]German, Italian, Russian and Polish languages added
[*]Steam Cloud support added
[*]Steam Achievements added
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta for HD Update
notes.content:
[h1]Dear loyal fans of Hotel Giant 2![/h1]

As you might noticed Hotel Giant 2 was not available for sale on Steam for a period of time. This was caused by some licensing issues but finally UIG Entertainment (holding all games of the famous “Giant” series) gained back the rights on the critically acclaimed Hotel Giant 2.

As we want to spice things up a little bit before putting the game live and available again on Steam we’ve decided to give the game a little makeover.

[h1]What has changed so far?[/h1]

[list]

[*]Widescreen support with additional resolutions of 1600x1200, 1680x1050, 1920x1080
[*]German and Italian language added
[*]Steam Cloud support added
[*]Some tweaks to optimize support on newer OS (Win 7 /8)

[/list]

[h1]What are the plans for the near future?[/h1]

[list]

[*]Add Steam Achievements
[*]Add further languages

[/list]

To make sure everything is working we want you to experience the significant changes so far and give you the possibility to pass your opinion. To do so please join the Hotel Giant 2 Update Open Beta.

[h1]How to?[/h1]

[olist]

[*]Right-click on Hotel Giant 2 in your Steam library
[*]Choose properties
[*]Go to the “Beta” tab
[*]Choose “open_beta” from the dropdown field
[*]Download the update

[/olist]

[h1]Anything else?[/h1]

Please be aware that if you decide to opt out of the open beta (and revert to the original build) for any reasons, you might experience that the game will freeze when loading. In this case simply delete the “VCONFIG.DAT” in “user/documents/my games/Hotel Giant 2”.

Check out Hotel Giant 2 in Full HD and don’t forget to give your feedback in the Steam forums.
